name: skills
description: List, show, search, or enable/disable markdown skills in skills/ (agent.skills_dir). Same discovery the system prompt uses: *.md, no SYSTEM.md, at least 20 bytes, sorted, frontmatter plus state/skills.json enable. Input: {} lists name/title/description/bytes/enabled; {"name":"research"} shows one body; {"query":"facts"} lists matching skills; {"action":"set_enabled","name":"research","enabled":false} turns one off without rewriting the file.
llm_description: List/show/search/toggle skill markdown files (skills/). {} lists; {name} shows one; {query} searches; action set_enabled{name,enabled} writes state/skills.json. Prompt inlines title+description only.

name.description: Skill basename or stem (research or research.md). Omit to list.

query.description: Case-insensitive search across name, title, description, and body.

enabled.description: With action set_enabled, whether the skill rides the next prompt.
